Legs.Subject: BitWords over a random 128-bit mask and a sparse mask built from it, each read as a UInt128 and as the same bits in two 64-bit words: the members both enumerators visit, Count, Span, Contains from -1 through 128, Bit and every Word32.
Legs.Against: A bit-by-bit test of the two raw words by shift and mask, which calls no BitWords member: the ascending list of set positions, its length, one past its last entry, and each 32-bit quarter of the raw words.

Legs.Subject: Add and Remove over three words, Contains past the span and below zero, WordsFor at the word boundaries, and the refusals of Bit, Word32 and WordsFor outside their ranges.
Legs.Against: Every seventh position set by construction and the known count after one removal; the word counts of the ceiling division by 64 written out.

Legs.Subject: Shift of seeded spans of one to seven words into destinations up to two words wider, at every signed distance up to two words past the span either way; Extract of every fifth start and seventh length of run, past the span's end included, into a destination one word wider than the run and filled with set bits; Complement of every set width from 0 to 200 positions over seeded words one word longer than the set; and the refusals of a negative start, length or width and a short destination.
Legs.Against: A bit-by-bit copy of the raw words by index arithmetic, which calls no BitWords member: destination bit b equals source bit b - distance, clear outside the source, run bit b equals source bit start + b below the run's length and is clear from there on, and complement bit b is the flipped source bit below the width, clear up to the end of the set's last word, and untouched past it.
